        In Progress

        Ritzy Mobility Partner Service Agreement

        Effective Date: Upon execution of this Agreement

        This Partner Service Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into between Ritzy Mobility Pvt. Ltd. ("Ritzy"), a company incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013, having its registered office at 801, Emerald Tower, Bandra Kurla Complex, Mumbai — 400051, and the Partner entity completing this onboarding portal.

        1. Scope of Services. Ritzy shall provide EV-powered employee transport solutions as mutually agreed in the Schedule of Services appended hereto. The Partner shall ensure accurate employee roster data is submitted at least 5 working days before the go-live date.

        2. Term. This Agreement shall be valid for a period of 12 months from the go-live date, with an option to renew upon mutual written consent.

        3. Payment Terms. Invoices shall be raised on the 1st of each month for the preceding month's services. Payment is due within 15 days of invoice date. Late payments attract an interest of 1.5% per month.

        4. Confidentiality. Both parties agree to maintain strict confidentiality of all proprietary information exchanged during the partnership. This obligation survives termination of this Agreement.

        5. Data Privacy. All employee data shared with Ritzy shall be used solely for the purpose of providing transport services. Ritzy shall comply with all applicable data protection laws.

        6. Termination. Either party may terminate this Agreement with 30 days' written notice. Ritzy reserves the right to immediate termination in case of material breach.

        7. Dispute Resolution. Any disputes shall be resolved through binding arbitration in Mumbai under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996.
